Privacy policy

NEXUS OS · last updated 24 August 2026

In one sentence: NEXUS OS uses the dealership owner's own Google account to send the dealership's own email. It is not a product with users, it does not sell data, and it shares nothing with advertisers.

Who operates this application

NEXUS OS is operated by the owner of a single automotive dealership for that dealership's own operations. It is not distributed, resold, or offered for public sign-up.

What Google data is accessed, and why

When the dealership owner connects their Google account, the application is granted permission to send email as that account. It uses this for exactly two things:

  • replying to and following up with customers who contacted the dealership;
  • alerting the dealership's own staff when a lead needs attention.

Every message is one the dealership would otherwise have written by hand.

What is stored

  • An OAuth token for the connected Google account, held encrypted in the dealership's own n8n instance so email can be sent without signing in each time. It is never transmitted anywhere else.
  • A record of messages sent — recipient, timestamp and content — kept in the dealership's private database so staff can see the history of a conversation.

Mailbox contents are not read, indexed, downloaded or scanned. The permission granted is to send.

What is never done

  • Google user data is never sold, rented or shared with advertisers or data brokers.
  • It is never used to train machine-learning models, ours or anyone else's.
  • It is never transferred to a third party except where the dealership is legally required to produce it.

Where data lives

On infrastructure the dealership controls: a private virtual machine and a private Supabase database. Access is restricted to the dealership's own staff accounts.

How long it is kept

Message history is kept while the customer relationship is active. Identity documents collected for the compliance checks a vehicle sale requires are deleted automatically on a retention schedule.

Revoking access

The connected Google account can withdraw this application's access at any time at myaccount.google.com/permissions. Access ends immediately and the stored token stops working.

Limited Use

NEXUS OS's use and transfer of information received from Google APIs adheres to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.

Contact

Questions about this policy, or a request to delete data: aliasgher892@gmail.com.

NEXUS OS — automotive dealership operations. Contact: aliasgher892@gmail.com
